deterministic.warning: Anyone with the seed, context and algorithm can calculate the event result.

local_live.warning: The local authority can discard and reroll unless the append-only ledger is enforced.

mixed_live.implementation: SHA-256 mix of event context, deterministic campaign component and fresh OS entropy
mixed_live.warning: This is replayable after resolution because the live token is logged.

external_beacon.implementation: Pinned drand quicknet packet identity, SHA-256(signature) check, and fail-closed BLS12-381 G1 signature verification before event mixing
external_beacon.warning: Packets are rejected when the BLS verifier is missing, errors, or returns false. For fairness, commit to a future round before publication.

best_for: human and AI parties jointly contributing uncertainty
party_commit.implementation: SHA-256 commitments followed by verified reveals and combined contributions
party_commit.warning: The starter detects changed reveals but does not prevent a participant from refusing to reveal.

nist_randomness_beacon.authority: National Institute of Standards and Technology
nist_randomness_beacon.relevance: Timed public randomness pulses with metadata, signatures and hash chaining.

drand.relevance: Distributed publicly verifiable randomness based on threshold BLS signatures.

coin_flipping_commitments.authority: Manuel Blum / IBM Research publication record
coin_flipping_commitments.relevance: Foundational commit-before-reveal approach for remote joint randomness.
